audience_situation: A creator has owned source material and needs work they can review and use.
current_promise: Candidate pending task verification: create a browser-local draft, inspect its proof gaps and export a working packet.
future_capability_boundary: Do not claim persistent CreatorPack storage from a browser-local demo.
voluntary_identity: I finish and take responsibility for my creative work.

cue.reference: Use the approved current GenCreator identity and the source-to-review-to-export sequence.
cue.state: Existing identity reference to be resolved and approved for this task; no new mark selected.

first_value.action: Review the draft and complete an export.

proof.required: A real exported specimen and current product demonstration.

next_action: Create a second artifact from the same source when useful.

cross_brand_handoff.condition: Only after a relevant user need; do not force a portfolio detour.

measurement.primary: Reviewed artifact export completion among assigned eligible users.
measurement.return: Second meaningful completed artifact within 14 days.
measurement.stop_rule: Stop on a broken task, misleading capability claim or unintended publication; declare statistical stopping rule before launch.

product_specification.precedence: Current product decision governs proposition and availability; approved identity references govern visual identity.
